title: Heterogeneous Network Simulation for Return-Visit-Aware FANET Routing
description: A modular simulation environment for autonomous flying ad hoc networks (FANETs) with pluggable routing algorithms and support for both simulated and real-world UAV hardware (DJI Tello, CoDrone).
references: Erkalkan, E., Topuz, V., & Buldu, A. (2024). Addressing the Return Visit Challenge in Autonomous Flying Ad Hoc Networks Linked to a Central Station. Sensors, 24(23), 7859.
